verdict.rationale: The axis applies: a card-issuing platform can reasonably offer PCI-scoped card-detail reveal. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions hosted card-detail components, ephemeral-key reveal flows, PAN/CVV display, or PCI/SAQ scope reduction. The items cover card creation, digital wallets, spending controls and the agent virtual cards, none of which address showing card details to cardholders.

support.subject: As a developer, I can show cardholders their own PAN and CVV without inheriting PCI scope — hosted components or ephemeral-key reveal flows the vendor documents as keeping me out of SAQ D
